title: Turn location on or off in Settings

setup.why: Keep the phone's own location state once (true or false), so teardown puts it back.
Start from the other state, so the agent has to change it.
Open Settings at its home page, whatever screen an earlier run left it on.

instruction: Using the Settings app, turn location {{mode.say}} for the whole phone.

checks.why: LocationManager's master switch for the current user: `cmd location is-location-enabled` prints true or false. Setup left the other value, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Put the phone's own location state back when it was saved, and drop the saved copy.

argv: f=/data/local/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}.orig; v=$(cat $f 2>/dev/null); case "$v" in true|false) cmd location set-location-enabled $v ;; esac; rm -f $f
